title: VDBE P4 attachment, dispatch, operation-array, and object destruction

scope.rationale: These seven coupled routines own the complete active-profile P4 attach/replace/release path and recursively retire operation arrays, subprograms, and VDBE objects. Keeping them together closes every owner transition from attachment through statement deletion.
excluded_responsibilities: P4 leaf destructors and VTable/KeyInfo/Table ownership internals assigned to dependency units
Inactive normalize, explain-comment, and statement-scan-status branches

external_source_responsibilities: Compiler callers provide P4 values paired with the exact P4 type and connection owner
dependencies.caller_closure: The active-profile attach, replace, dispatch, recursive operation/subprogram cleanup, list unlink, and VDBE free functions are all assigned; reset/finalize caller sequencing remains separate.

inputs: INIT-state VDBE and valid operation address or latest-operation sentinel
P4 pointer/integer/string paired with exact ownership type
VDBE object linked into its connection list for final deletion
outputs: Attached static, integer, copied-string, VTable, or owned P4 payload
Reverse-order owned-P4 release and operation-array free
Recursive subprogram/body release, connection-list unlink, and VDBE free
contracts.ownership: P4_DYNAMIC and other owning types transfer to the operation; replacement is permitted only for non-owning/inline P4 values. OOM consumes incoming owned P4 except P4_VTAB. Final deletion recursively consumes every operation-owned payload and allocation.
contracts.state_and_results: P4 change preserves INIT state and resolves negative addresses to the latest operation. Deletion unlinks only outside byte-count accounting mode, exactly matching the source ownership walk.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds the connection mutex. P4_VTAB release may synchronously invoke virtual-table/module callbacks. No direct I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Sticky OOM prevents attachment, consumes eligible incoming owners, and leaves the operation unchanged. Cleanup performs no allocation and remains valid during OOM or byte-count accounting.

representation_differences: The pointer-overloaded C ChangeP4 API is split into pointer, int32, and string Zig entry points so invalid pointer/integer reinterpretation is unrepresentable.
The source recursive P4 and VDBE owner graph is preserved with typed Zig pointers; only boundary casts to opaque allocator storage remain.
Inactive-profile explain comments, normalization owners, and scan-status owners are compile-time absent rather than runtime branches.

oracle.protocol: The shared symbolic worker attaches static, int32, copied-string, VTable, and dynamic P4 values; replaces eligible values; forces ChangeP4 and AppendP4 OOM; releases owned payloads in operation arrays; and deletes linked VDBEs. C and Zig compare 366 observations.
internal_observations: negative-address resolution and exact P4 type/value
reverse operation-owner release and complete linked-VDBE retirement
oracle.normalization: Pointers normalize only to identity relations and membership in connection lookaside free lists. P4 types, values, counts, OOM state, callback effects, and list state are exact.

assurance.oom: Differential cases force ChangeP4 and AppendP4 OOM and verify incoming dynamic owners are consumed while operation state remains unused; all cleanup runs under connection ownership.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No direct I/O; VTable callback behavior is covered by its dependency unit and production mutex sequencing remains integration work.
assurance.malformed_input: Typed APIs and assertions enforce INIT state, operation bounds, replaceable P4 classes, and valid owner/type pairings.
assurance.continuation: OOM is explicitly cleared by the worker and subsequent case cleanup retires all operations without leaks or double frees.
assurance.performance: Latest-operation lookup and append remain constant time; operation destruction preserves the source reverse linear ownership walk.

integration.native_call_path: The native symbolic builder now creates, attaches, replaces, releases, and deletes exact source-layout VDBE operations and objects.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Compiler execution/reset/finalize integration must switch to this lifecycle before the handwritten scaffold can be removed.

independent_review.notes: Requires reset/finalize integration, broad assurance, and independent fidelity review.

known_blockers: Port and integrate VDBE halt/reset/finalize sequencing around this destruction path.
Switch compiler production ownership to the source-layout VDBE builder.

callers: Compiler helper families attach static, copied/dynamic, integer, function/context, KeyInfo, VTable, TableRef, SubrtnSig, Mem and SubProgram payloads

callees: freeP4 dispatches each active owning P4 class: direct connection free, KeyInfo unref, leaf FuncDef/Mem/Context, VTable unlock/callback chain, Table delete, or SubrtnSig nested affinity/free
freeOperationArray walks operations in reverse, releases only p4type<=P4_FREE_IF_LE, then frees the array

assertions_branches_cleanup: All 72 behavior IDs cover every active P4 case, reverse owner walk, replace/attach/OOM branches, object state branches, recursive subprogram cleanup, list unlink and final free
Replacement is allowed only when old P4 is non-owning/inline; incoming owning values transfer or are consumed on OOM so no double owner remains
Byte-count accounting suppresses KeyInfo/VTable/Table destructive ref transitions and connection unlink exactly as source
Normalize, explain-comment, cursor-hint expression, and statement-scan-status branches are inactive or excluded
upstream_tests: Upstream prepare/finalize/reset, function/aggregate/window, vtab, trigger/subprogram, schema/TableRef, OOM, and memory accounting suites exercise owner families
